generate_seq2seq_hypotheses: generate sequence-to-sequence hypotheses using ScriptedSequenceGenerator.generate_hypo with source tokens and optional dictionary features
run_beam_search_decode: run beam search and decode on source tokens using ScriptedSequenceGenerator.forward with src_tokens and src_lengths
create_sequence_generator_from_config: create a ScriptedSequenceGenerator instance from a Config object using the from_config class method
compute_target_length: compute the target output length using get_target_length with a quadratic formula capped by targetlen_cap
review_beam_search_config: review the ScriptedSequenceGenerator.Config class to understand beam_size, length_penalty, nbest, and stop_at_eos defaults
